{"CommandLine":"& "D:\CareBridge AI\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -c "
from app import create_app
from app.core.database import get_database

app = create_app()
client = app.test_client()
db = get_database()

email = 'test_patient_live_check@carebridge.ai'
db.users.delete_many({'email': email})
db.patients.delete_many({'email': email})

reg_payload = {
    'name': 'Live Test Patient',
    'email': email,
    'password': 'Password#2026!Secure',
    'phone': '+91 9876543210',
    'age': 29,
    'gender': 'Male',
    'blood_group': 'O+'
}
res = client.post('/api/auth/register', json=reg_payload)
print('Register status:', res.status_code)
reg_json = res.get_json()
print('Register message:', reg_json.get('message'))
assert res.status_code == 201
assert 'access_token' in reg_json
assert reg_json['user']['email'] == email
assert reg_json['user']['role'] == 'PATIENT'

# 2. Duplicate registration test
dup_res = client.post('/api/auth/register', json=reg_payload)
print('Duplicate register status:', dup_res.status_code)
assert dup_res.status_code == 409

# 3. Login test
login_res = client.post('/api/auth/login', json={'email': email, 'password': 'Password#2026!Secure'})
print('Login status:', login_res.status_code)
login_json = login_res.get_json()
assert login_res.status_code == 200
token = login_json['access_token']
print('Login success! User role:', login_json['user']['role'])

# 4. /auth/me test
me_res = client.get('/api/auth/me', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'})
print('Auth /me status:', me_res.status_code)
me_json = me_res.get_json()
assert me_res.status_code == 200
assert me_json['email'] == email

# 5. Invalid credentials test
bad_res = client.post('/api/auth/login', json={'email': email, 'password': 'WrongPassword123!'})
print('Bad credentials status:', bad_res.status_code)
assert bad_res.status_code == 401

print('ALL AUTH BACKEND TESTS PASSED SUCCESSFULLY!')
"","Cwd":"d:\CareBridge AI\backend","WaitMsBeforeAsync":10000,"toolAction":"Running auth test in venv","toolSummary":"Run venv test suite"}
